query.content: What function calculates the Vortex Indicator positive line (VI+) from high, low, and close price series using a configurable lookback length, including rolling positive and true-range movement sums, and returns the latest value rounded to four decimal places?

```python
def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    highs = [120, 122, 125, 123, 126, 124, 127, 129, 130, 128, 131, 133, 134, 135, 136, 137, 138, 139]
    lows = [118, 120, 121, 119, 123, 122, 124, 126, 127, 126, 128, 130, 131, 132, 133, 134, 135, 136]
    closes = [119, 121, 123, 120, 125, 123, 126, 128, 129, 127, 130, 132, 133, 134, 135, 136, 137, 138]
    parameter_length = 14

    true_ranges = []
    vm_plus = []

    for i in range(1, len(highs)):
        true_range = max(
            highs[i] - lows[i],
            abs(highs[i] - closes[i - 1]),
            abs(lows[i] - closes[i - 1])
        )
        true_ranges.append(true_range)
        vm_plus.append(abs(highs[i] - lows[i - 1]))

    # Calculate the final VI+ value using the last 14 periods
    sum_tr = sum(true_ranges[-parameter_length:])
    sum_vm_plus = sum(vm_plus[-parameter_length:])
    vi_plus = sum_vm_plus / sum_tr

    # Return the answer rounded to four decimal places
    return round(vi_plus, 4)
```
